services.desc: Gulf Coast Party Boats transforms ordinary events into parties to remember forever! 2 hours Person: $59.95 Private Charter: $750 (Monday - Thursday, Friday - Sunday 10am-11am) $850 (Friday - Sunday after 11am) About Gulf Coast Party Boats is a tiki-style party cruise line offering a fun and unique experience for your group or individuals. Our cruises are approximately two hours long and passengers are welcome to bring their own drinks and food on board. More info Though we love our fur-babies, pets/animals are not permitted on board the vessel. There is plenty of free parking $59.95-$850 • Tiki style boat! • 2 hours • Up to 30 people

quotes.text: The experience was very nice. It was my friends birthday party. She wanted to do some different really enjoy the ride not a lot of ways and just a smooth ride. A lot of fun book your ride today.
We had a blast with James and Abbey! They showed us a good time all while ensuring we were safe! Can’t wait to do it again! And it was raining we still enjoyed ourselves 10/10.
Captain James was amazing!!! Very responsive to all calls and text!! The boat and bathroom was clean!! My husband 43rd B- Day was amazing!
We had the best time celebrating birthdays tonight!! Captain James and Abbie were incredible hosts. Super accommodating and very friendly.
